narratives.name: Documentaries & Narratives
narratives.intro: Stories shaped by character, emotion, and the details that stay with us.
items: Emotions are part of our everyday lives, occupying our thoughts and shaping how we experience the world. Voice explores the emotions that stay with us, often becoming a constant presence in our minds.
A short public service message exploring the weight of social expectations and the influence of what others might think.

Ignorance and neglect may leave a person in darkness, but they cannot take away their vision. A boy learns to feel the light and embrace it, allowing others to witness the fruits of his hard work, vision, and success.
A tribute to Dilip Kumar and the artists behind the song, recreating a memorable piece of classic Indian cinema.
A darkly humorous tribute to every lost video, vanished project, and editor’s worst fear.

A corporate documentary showcasing Smart Innovations, its products, vision, and business portfolio through interviews, B-roll, and product visuals.
